launches.title: Illuminant Surgical: A new way of seeing inside the human body
launches.tagline: Displaying images directly on the patient for safer, faster procedures
launches.body:
**💡TL;DR**

* We give doctors X-ray vision without the need for headsets or monitors.
* It works in any operating room, requires zero wearables, and seamlessly integrates into existing workflows.
* We're starting with spine surgery, pain management, and interventional radiology - 11M+ annual procedures in the U.S.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=65365&key=user_uploads/636938/0a341696-1b40-4543-b52f-2cc145a6579f)

**❌ The Problem: Patient Access Is Stuck In The 1800s**

Every year, hundreds of millions of procedures require precise access to internal anatomy. Whether placing a screw in the spine, inserting a needle for a biopsy, or advancing a catheter, precision is critical. Yet surgeons still rely on outdated tools: fluoroscopy, “feel”, and mental reconstruction, leading to inefficiencies, complications, and billions in unnecessary healthcare costs.

This has serious consequences:

* For patients – misplaced implants, vascular injuries, and nerve damage result in repeat procedures, extended hospital stays, and life-altering complications.
* For hospitals – preventable surgical revisions cost tens of billions annually in unnecessary expenses
* For surgeons – Cumbersome tools and methods that extend case time, increase cognitive load, and limit the number of patients they can treat.

Spine surgery and interventional access are two of the fastest-growing segments and also among the most accuracy-dependent.

In the US alone:

* 1.6 M spine surgeries where millimeters can mean the difference between mobility and disability.
* 9.5 M interventional procedures that rely on accurate percutaneous access to treat and diagnose hundreds of different conditions and diseases.

**This is a $10B+ unmet need.**

**🔎 Our Solution: See Inside The Patient in Real Time, Directly On The Body**

We’ve built a new way of seeing inside the human body: Skylight is the first real-time anatomical projection system built to solve the problems with patient access. Instead of forcing doctors to look away at a screen, Skylight projects anatomy directly onto the patient, like an AR display—but without headsets, wearables, or extra steps.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=65365&key=user_uploads/636938/8f98ebe8-aa8b-44e5-aac5-1b03d5105bfd)

To make this happen, we’ve developed a novel method of tracking the patient with sub-millimeter accuracy and we’ve built this system to be universally compatible with industry-standard tools and scanners to allow adoption without changing workflow.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=65365&key=user_uploads/636938/d4213fc6-0747-4211-8bc3-56a309fd14c9)

**Just as fiber optics revolutionized how we do laparoscopy and minimally invasive surgeries, anatomical projection will become the new standard for patient access.**

**Who We Are:**

We’re James and Eldrick, two Stanford engineers who first met as freshman dormmates and have now worked together for over a decade.

💉James: MD, bioengineer, scientist, and medical device builder.

⚙️ Eldrick: Experienced deep-tech founder. Built chips at Apple and led hardware-software teams at a lidar startup.

We’ve assembled a world-class team of engineers, clinicians, and medical device experts to solve tough problems at the intersection of medicine, computer vision, graphics, and hardware development.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=65365&key=user_uploads/636938/f5a0197a-718d-45cf-b2bd-f71769312830)

**We’re looking for:**

🩺 Clinicians → If you do spine, pain management, or IR, let’s talk.

🏥 Hospital Partners → Want to be at the forefront of procedural navigation? Reach out.

📰 Media → We’re redefining how doctors see. Let’s get the word out.

Email us [founders@illuminant.ai](mailto:founders@illuminant.ai) 💡

name: Weel
long_description: Weel is the next-generation all-in-one driver co-pilot that redefines your driving experience by turning your smartphone into a complete safety and navigation hub. Our free app offers a built-in dashcam with easy video sharing, a smart navigation system, and advanced AI features—such as augmented reality navigation and ADAS—that reduce your risk by up to 30%. Say goodbye to expensive dashcams and complex setups – with Weel, you get complete driving safety and guidance in one free smartphone app.

launches.title: Weel: The First GPS App with a Built-in Dashcam
launches.tagline: Turn your smartphone into a AI-powered dashcam & GPS.
launches.body:
### **👋 Hi YC!**

We’re Raphaël and David, and we’re building **Weel — the first GPS app with a built-in dashcam** that works with the phone you already own.

**TL;DR**

Weel turns your smartphone into a dual-facing dashcam and full GPS navigation app — no cables, no SD cards, no new hardware. It records your trips, uploads them securely to the cloud, and gives you evidence in case of incidents.\
→ **100% free to use on iOS & Android**

Download here:[ https://onelink.to/fk9tyg](https://onelink.to/fk9tyg)

**🎥 Demo Video**

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Gz5eFEN_WNw

**The Problem: Dashcams today are too expensive, messy, and complicated**

Dashcams are incredibly valuable: some insurers offer **up to 30% discounts** to drivers who are equipped with one, and footage can make all the difference in resolving accidents or preventing fraud.

Yet most drivers still don’t use them.

We’ve spent weeks testing the most popular dashcams on the market. What did we find?

💸 High cost (up to $550)\
🔧 Installation headaches — some even require professional wiring\
📼 Local-only footage (SD cards, no cloud)\
🚙 Easy to steal if left in the car

📸 Here's what that looks like in real life:

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=91925&key=user_uploads/1979026/14f1457a-7457-4463-9d3d-7e08e114cd81)

**Our Solution: Weel replaces all of that with a simple app**

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=91925&key=user_uploads/1979026/189d2815-2212-4495-80f4-d82616412f65)

\
Weel is a smartphone app that offers:

* **External dashcam** — Records the road ahead and provides incident evidence in case of an accident
* **Internal dashcam** — Designed for professional drivers (taxis, VTCs, delivery) to ensure security and accountability
* **Smart navigation** — Real-time GPS guidance with traffic-aware routing
* **Cloud & encryption** — Video footage is uploaded via Wi-Fi and encrypted for secure storage
* **Accident analysis** _(in beta)_ — Automatically analyzes and describes what happened during a crash, to simplify reporting and defend the driver

**Why are we building this?**

For months, we’ve been speaking with both professional and everyday drivers — many shared stories of accidents where, without any footage, they lost time, money, and even saw their insurance premiums double. They had no way to defend themselves.

We believe that access to protection, evidence, and safer driving shouldn’t be a luxury — this kind of technology should be available to **everyone**, for **free**.

**What’s next?**

Our goal is to develop a full suite of AI computer vision features such as:

* **Real-time alerts** — Warnings for risky driving behavior to help prevent incidents
* **Augmented reality navigation** — Smarter, clearer GPS guidance using AR overlays
* **Video-based traffic reports** — Automatic detection of traffic jams, hazards, and incidents from user dashcams

to create a large, connected and safe driver network improving traffic flow across cities.\
\
**🙏 Ask**

Want to help us make driving safer for everyone?\
Try Weel for free today on iOS & Android →[ ](https://onelink.to/fk9tyg)[https://onelink.to/fk9tyg](https://onelink.to/fk9tyg%5C) \
\
If you have feedback, product ideas, or just want to connect — feel free to reach out at [**raphael@weel.live**](mailto:raphael@weel.live). We'd love to hear from you.

name: Streamline Systems
long_description:
Streamline Systems is building the replacement for GPS. 

Satellite positioning has become the single point of failure for almost every modern system, both military and civil. We've built the replacement. A drop-in module that integrates with existing Ardupilot, INAV and PX4 flight controllers, with demonstrated satellite-independent autonomous flight and GPS handoff. We're currently working with commercial and military end users to deploy the capability.
one_liner: Precision navigation for UAVs operating without GPS.
